---
title: Usage
subtitle: Folium Typst template guide
description: "Set up and render NBIS reports with the Folium Typst template."
format: html
---

## Start a project

Create a project from the template:

```bash
quarto use template royfrancis/quarto-typst-folium
```

Use `report.qmd` as the starting point. `demo.qmd` contains examples of supported Quarto and Typst features.

## Configure the report

Set report-specific cover information in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
nbis:
  id: "0000"
  contributors:
    - name: "Person A"
      email: "name@nbis.se"
      affiliation: "NBIS"
      roles: "NBIS Staff"
    - name: "Person B"
      email: "name@example.com"
      affiliation: "Some university"
      roles: "Principal Investigator"
```

`name` is required. `email` is optional. `affiliation` and `roles` accept either a string or a list. Contributors without a role appear under **Contributor**.

The cover defaults to class `NBIS REPORT`, the bundled NBIS logo and background, a logo height of `0.8cm`, and a font size of `12pt`. Override any of them under `nbis`:

```yaml
nbis:
  class: "NBIS PROJECT PLAN"
  logo:
    path: assets/logos/custom-logo.svg
  logo-height: 1cm
  font-size: 11pt
  background:
    path: assets/images/custom-bg.png
```

The extension provides the PDF defaults, including A4 paper, Lato, one column, section numbering, a table of contents, and report margins. Enable the format in `_quarto.yml` with:

```yaml
format:
  folium-typst: default
```

Project or document settings override these defaults. For example:

```yaml
format:
  folium-typst:
    papersize: us-letter
    columns: 2
    toc: false
```

Document frontmatter supplies the report text:

```yaml
---
title: Report title
subtitle: NBIS Support 0000
description: Short project description.
date: last-modified
date-format: "DD MMM YYYY"
---
```

Use `##` for top-level body headings because the document title occupies level 1.

## Contents and columns

For a contents page, add:

````markdown
```{=typst}
#outline()
#pagebreak()
```
````

For a two-column report, set `columns: 2`. The cover remains one column automatically. Keep the contents page one column with:

````markdown
```{=typst}
#single-column[
  #outline()
  #pagebreak()
]
```
````

See `demo-2col.qmd` for a complete example.

## Render

Render one PDF:

```bash
quarto render report.qmd --to folium-typst
```

Render the full project:

```bash
quarto render
```

Output is written to `docs/`. Standard Quarto Markdown features such as citations, cross-references, tables, figures, callouts, and code blocks are supported.
